1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 g6 4.d4 exd4 5.N.strategy: Plants the knight on an outpost Black's pawns cannot easily challenge: the e-pawn is gone and the c-pawn is blocked by its own knight. From d5 it eyes c7 and f6, and the d4 pawn is still to be won back, so White keeps the initiative.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.Nc3 g6 4.d4 exd4 5.N.name: Three Knights Opening: Steinitz-Rosenthal Variation
